supported.follow_up: Inspect the current test record and retain the narrow test-pass claim.

contradicted.follow_up: Report the failed test and investigate the duplicate record.

unrelated-test.follow_up: Run a retry idempotency check. Do not infer a retry failure from missing coverage.

partial-coverage.follow_up: Inspect the full suite and the required failure modes before making a coverage claim.

stale-revision.follow_up: Run the test at r2. Do not treat the r1 result as a current pass or failure.

conflicting-runs.follow_up: Retrieve the original logs for runs A and B and resolve the inconsistent summaries.

source-instructions.follow_up: Ignore instructions embedded in evidence and obtain an actual test record.

negated-claim.follow_up: Correct the negated claim using the passing test record.

conflict-reversed.follow_up: Inspect both original runs and their conditions before reporting a consistent pass.

current-over-stale.follow_up: Retain the narrow current-pass claim after inspecting the r2 run.

narrow-coverage.follow_up: Retain the narrow test-existence claim without claiming that it passed.

assertion-not-execution.follow_up: Run the integration check. A test definition does not show that it passed.

requirement-met.follow_up: Inspect the current test run and mark acceptance criterion 1 as met.

requirement-paraphrase.follow_up: Inspect the end-to-end run and mark the user story as met.

requirement-flag-only.follow_up: Run export with --dry-run and check that no files are written. A parser option does not show the behavior.

requirement-unaddressed.follow_up: Report the retry limit as unaddressed. Implement or test it before calling the work complete.

requirement-unmet.follow_up: Report the unmet retry limit and investigate the extra attempts.

requirement-partial-scope.follow_up: Run a YAML config check before marking the requirement met. Do not treat missing coverage as a failure.
